fact: Home Affairs built a real-time employee verification portal for National Treasury, linked to the population register, to check government payroll records, going live 15 June 2026 per the department.

National Treasury says it is cross-checking the PERSAL civil service payroll with SARS tax data and Home Affairs population and biometric data, testing PERSAL for ID numbers with several PERSAL numbers, with no final results and a data-sharing legal framework and MOU still being set up.

The Department of Home Affairs says it is deploying a biometric verification solution to interface with national population and payroll databases under DPSA Circular 36 of 2025, with verification still underway and a report due 28 February 2026.
